title: Keto Pork Chops with Beer Broth
description: A keto twist on a classic pork chop dish, featuring a rich beer broth and a silky sauce.

ingredients.name: Nutty Parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped parsley adds a nice crunch

ingredients.name: Silky Sour Cream
ingredients.notes: Thickens the sauce and adds creaminess

instructions: Season the pork chops with Croatian paprika and nutty parsley.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the pork chops for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the pork chops to a baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the pork chops are baking, simmer the beer and broth in a saucepan over low heat until reduced by half.
Stir in silky sour cream and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pork chops with the beer broth sauce spooned over the top.
